request.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real material texture, soft natural light and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. No letters, words, logos or brand marks anywhere, including on buildings, signs, vehicles, clothing and screens, except the symbols the prompt explicitly asks for. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Every hand has five natural fingers. Do not imitate earlier course photos.

Keep every person, building and object the meaning depends on inside the central 55 percent of the photo width, so a centered 4:5 crop keeps them whole; only expendable background reaches the left and right edges.

Inside a modern public library with tall bookshelves on both sides, a woman in her twenties with short curly red hair and a mustard sweater stands between the shelves and takes a book from a shelf at shoulder height, smiling. The shelves full of books make the place read instantly as a library. She is the only person; no text or signs.
